Vilvah Goat Milk Shampoo is a creamy everyday shampoo made with goat milk, jasmine flower water and hydrolysed pea protein. It works into a soft lather and carries a light floral jasmine scent.

Key ingredients

  • Goat milk: a creamy base that leaves hair feeling soft after washing
  • Jasmine flower water: gives the shampoo its gentle floral scent
  • Hydrolysed pea protein: a plant protein that helps hair feel smoother and easier to manage
  • Jojoba and wheat germ oils with panthenol: condition the lengths and add shine
  • Coco betaine and disodium cocoyl glutamate: mild cleansers that wash away build-up

How to use

Wet hair well, massage a coin-sized amount into the scalp and let the lather run through the lengths. Rinse thoroughly and repeat if your hair is very oily. Follow with conditioner on the mid-lengths and ends.

Good to know

  • Sizes: 200 ml, 250 ml and 500 ml
  • Suits dry hair and a sensitive scalp
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Cream Conditioner 250ML or Vilvah Goat Milk Shampoo 250ML

This 250 ml bottle of Vilvah Goat Milk Shampoo holds the same goat milk and jasmine formula in a mid-sized bottle. The texture is creamy and the lather soft, so it suits regular washing of dry lengths. A floral note from jasmine flower water and jasmine oil comes through as you rinse.

Key ingredients

  • Goat milk: rich and milky, for hair that feels soft and less dry after a wash
  • Hydrolysed keratin and panthenol: conditioning ingredients that help strands feel smooth
  • Hydrolysed pea protein: helps lengths feel more manageable
  • Jojoba seed oil: a light plant oil that adds shine

How to use

  • Apply a small amount to soaked hair and work it through the scalp with your fingertips.
  • Rinse well with lukewarm water.
  • Finish with a conditioner, or a hair mask once a week for very dry ends.

Good to know

  • Size: 250 ml
  • Suits dry hair
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Goat Milk Hair Mask or Vilvah Goat Milk Shampoo in 200 ml

Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Concentrate is a lightweight face serum in a 30 ml bottle, made for daily use under moisturiser. The fluid texture spreads easily and sinks in quickly, so skin feels hydrated and smoother without a heavy layer. It fits easily into a morning and evening routine.

What it is

  • A hydrating serum from Shiseido's Ultimune line
  • Light, fluid texture that layers well under cream and sunscreen
  • Made for everyday use, morning and night

How to use

Cleanse your face, then press one or two pumps into the skin of the face and neck. Let it settle for a moment before your moisturiser. In the morning, finish with sunscreen. Patch test before first use if your skin is sensitive.

Good to know

  • Size: 30 ml
  • Hydrating face serum for daily use
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Pairs well with: Shiseido Complete Cleansing Microfoam or Highborn London Organic Hydration Gel

Shiseido Complete Cleansing Microfoam is a foaming face cleanser in a 180 ml tube. A small amount whips into a fine, dense foam that lifts away dirt and the day's residue, leaving the face feeling fresh, soft and comfortable rather than tight. It is gentle enough for a morning and evening wash.

What it is

  • A cream-to-foam facial cleanser from Shiseido
  • Fine microfoam texture with a light, non-heavy rinse
  • Made for regular, everyday cleansing

How to use

  • Squeeze a pea-sized amount into damp palms and add a little water.
  • Work it into a foam between your hands.
  • Massage over a wet face, avoiding the eyes, then rinse with lukewarm water and pat dry.
  • Follow with toner, serum and moisturiser.

Good to know

  • Size: 180 ml
  • Daily face wash for morning and night
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Pairs well with: Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Concentrate or Highborn London Diamond Toner

Deyga Under Eye Cream is a light eye cream in a 15 g jar, made with aloe vera, cucumber hydrosol, almond oil and vitamin E. It feels cool as you apply it and absorbs quickly without a greasy finish, so it can sit under make-up. If you are looking for a simple under eye cream with a short ingredient list, this is a gentle place to start.

Key ingredients

  • Aloe vera extract: a cooling base that helps the eye area feel hydrated
  • Cucumber hydrosol: a fresh, light water that refreshes
  • Almond oil: a soft plant oil that nourishes the feel of the skin
  • Vitamin E: a skin-conditioning oil that keeps the cream comfortable

How to use

Morning and night, take a rice-sized amount on your ring finger. Dot it along the under eye area and tap it in gently, keeping away from the eye itself. Patch test before first use.

Good to know

  • Size: 15 g, single or pack of two
  • Suits sensitive skin
  • Contains almond oil
  • Official UK partner of Deyga, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Deyga Under Eye Mask or Deyga Light Moisturising Face Cream

The Deyga Best Selling Face Care Kit pairs the Deyga Charcoal Face Wash with the Beetroot Lip Balm Classic, a simple duo for face and lips. The face wash is a gel made with activated charcoal from coconut shell and tea tree hydrosol, and the balm is a beetroot-tinted mix of shea butter and plant oils.

What's in the kit

  • Charcoal Face Wash: coconut-derived cleansers with activated charcoal and tea tree hydrosol, for a fresh, clean-feeling face
  • Beetroot Lip Balm Classic: beetroot extract, shea butter, almond, avocado and jojoba oils with beeswax, for a soft rosy tint and smooth-feeling lips

How to use

  • Face wash: massage a small amount over a damp face, avoid the eyes, rinse well. Use morning and evening.
  • Lip balm: smooth over clean lips whenever they feel dry, and before bed.
  • Patch test before first use.

Good to know

  • One face wash and one Beetroot Lip Balm Classic
  • The balm contains almond oil and beeswax
  • Official UK partner of Deyga, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Deyga Light Moisturising Face Cream or Deyga Tea Tree Facial Toner

Deyga Spirulina Matcha Face Pack is a green powder face mask in a 150 g pack, blended from spirulina, matcha, neem leaf, moringa leaf and aloe vera powder. You mix it fresh with water each time you use it. Rinsed off, it leaves the face feeling clean and refreshed.

Key ingredients

  • Spirulina: a blue-green algae powder that gives the pack its deep colour
  • Matcha: finely ground green tea leaf
  • Neem and moringa leaf powders: traditional Indian leaf powders used in face packs
  • Aloe vera powder: adds a softer, comforting feel to the paste

How to use

Mix one to two teaspoons with water or rose water into a smooth paste. Spread an even layer over clean skin, avoiding the eyes and lips. Leave for 10 to 15 minutes then rinse with lukewarm water and follow with moisturiser. Use once or twice a week. Patch test before first use, and do not apply to broken or irritated skin.

Good to know

  • Size: 150 g powder
  • Official UK partner of Deyga, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Deyga Pure Rose Water Toner or Deyga Oat Milk Face Wash

Vilvah Fragrance-Free Cream Face Wash is a soft, creamy cleanser in a 100 ml tube, made with banana fruit extract and hydrolysed wheat protein. It uses mild plant-derived cleansers, disodium cocoyl glutamate and coco-glucoside, so the face feels clean without a tight, squeaky finish. There is no added fragrance.

Key ingredients

  • Disodium cocoyl glutamate and coco-glucoside: gentle cleansers that lather lightly
  • Banana fruit extract: helps skin feel soft and comfortable after rinsing
  • Hydrolysed wheat protein: leaves a smooth, conditioned feel
  • Glycerine: draws in water so skin feels hydrated

How to use

  • Wet your face and massage a pea-sized amount over the skin for about 30 seconds.
  • Rinse with lukewarm water and pat dry.
  • Use morning and evening, then follow with toner and moisturiser.

Good to know

  • Size: 100 ml
  • Suits sensitive skin
  • Contains wheat protein
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Milk Face Toner or Vilvah Ultra Moisturising Cream

Vilvah Ultra Moisturising Cream is a rich face moisturiser for dry skin in a 50 ml pack, made with olive squalane, vegetable glycerine and a touch of white lily essential oil. It spreads into a soft, non-greasy layer that leaves skin feeling supple and comfortable. A good choice for evenings or for skin that feels tight after cleansing.

Key ingredients

  • Olive squalane: a light, skin-friendly oil that helps hold in moisture
  • Vegetable glycerine: draws water into the skin so it feels hydrated
  • Caprylic/capric triglyceride: a smooth emollient that softens
  • Bamboo, goji berry and pyracantha extracts: plant extracts in a moisturising base
  • White lily essential oil: gives the cream its delicate scent

How to use

After cleansing and serum, warm a small amount between your fingertips and press it over the face and neck. Use morning and night, with sunscreen on top during the day. Patch test before first use.

Good to know

  • Size: 50 ml
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Milk Drops Hydrating Serum or Vilvah Natural Under Eye Cream

Vilvah Herbal Shampoo for Dandruff Control is a herbal shampoo made with neem leaf extract, tea tree oil, rosemary floral water and black pepper seed oil. It lathers with mild coconut-derived cleansers and has a fresh, herbal scent from its plant oils. Panthenol, jojoba oil and guar conditioning agents in the formula help hair feel soft after rinsing.

Key ingredients

  • Neem leaf extract: a traditional Indian botanical used in hair cleansers
  • Tea tree oil: a fresh, clean-smelling essential oil
  • Rosemary floral water: a light herbal water that adds to the scent
  • Amla (Phyllanthus emblica) extract: an Indian gooseberry extract used in hair care
  • Panthenol and jojoba oil: help hair feel soft and easy to comb

How to use

Wet hair well, massage a coin-sized amount into the scalp and through the lengths, then rinse thoroughly. Repeat if needed. Follow with a conditioner on the lengths. Keep out of the eyes.

Good to know

  • Sizes: 200 ml, 250 ml and 500 ml
  • Suits sensitive scalps
  • Contains wheat germ oil and essential oils
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Cream Conditioner 250ML or Vilvah Herbal Shampoo 250ML

The Vilvah Herbal Shampoo 250ML is the same herbal formula in a handy 250 ml bottle, for anyone who prefers a smaller size for travel or regular use. Its gentle, refreshing lather comes from coconut-derived cleansers, with basil leaf water, neem leaf extract and tangerine oil in the blend. Hair is left feeling clean, soft and easy to manage.

Key ingredients

  • Basil leaf water: a light herbal water that forms part of the base
  • Neem leaf extract: a classic botanical of Indian hair care
  • Tangerine (Citrus nobilis) oil: gives a bright, citrus note to the scent
  • Hydrolysed keratin and panthenol: condition the hair so it feels smooth

How to use

  • Work a small amount into a wet scalp with your fingertips.
  • Run the lather through to the ends, then rinse well.
  • Condition afterwards if your lengths feel dry.

Good to know

  • Size: 250 ml
  • Suits dry hair
  • Made with wheat germ oil, tea tree oil and black pepper seed oil
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Goat Milk Hair Mask or Vilvah Herbal Shampoo in 200 ml or 500 ml

Swansura Selection Caviar Serum with 24K Gold is a lightweight face serum made with tremella polysaccharide, sodium hyaluronate, aloe vera and oat kernel extract, finished with flakes of 24K gold leaf. It absorbs quickly and leaves skin feeling soft, smooth and hydrated, so it slips easily under a moisturiser.

Key ingredients

  • Sodium hyaluronate: a form of hyaluronic acid that holds water so skin feels hydrated
  • Tremella polysaccharide: a mushroom-derived ingredient that helps skin feel moisturised
  • Beta-glucan: a moisture-binding ingredient that adds to the hydrated feel
  • Aloe vera and oat kernel extract: light, comfortable plant ingredients
  • 24K gold leaf: fine gold flakes that give the serum its look

How to use

After cleansing and toning, smooth two or three drops over the face and neck, morning or evening. Let it sink in, then follow with your moisturiser, and add SPF in the daytime. Patch test before first use.

Good to know

  • Brand: Swansura Selection
  • Also contains amino acids, peptides and carnosine
  • Shipped from the UK
  • Pairs well with: 24K Gold Hydrating Face Mask or Highborn London Imperial Moisturiser

The Swansura Selection 24K Gold Hydrating Face Mask brings together real 24K gold, hyaluronic acid and polyglutamic acid with ceramides and shea butter. Plant extracts including centella asiatica, purslane, cactus and edelweiss join silk amino acids and hydrolysed collagen in the formula. It is made to leave skin feeling smooth, soft and hydrated, with a fresh look.

Key ingredients

  • Hyaluronic acid: holds water so skin feels hydrated
  • Polyglutamic acid: a moisture-binding ingredient that adds to that hydrated feel
  • Ceramides and shea butter: help skin feel moisturised and supple
  • Silk amino acids and hydrolysed collagen: leave skin feeling smooth
  • 24K gold: gives the mask its golden finish

How to use

Use on clean, dry skin as directed on the pack, avoiding the eye area. Afterwards, pat in any remaining product or rinse as the pack advises, then follow with a moisturiser. Patch test before first use.

Good to know

  • Brand: Swansura Selection
  • Also contains purslane, arnica and beta-glucan
  • Shipped from the UK
  • Pairs well with: Caviar Serum with 24K Gold or Highborn London Organic Hydration Gel

Vilvah Mango Shake Lip Balm is a tinted lip balm for dry lips, inspired by the flavour and colour of a classic mango milkshake. It is made with Alphonso mango pulp extract, mango butter, coconut milk and olive squalane, and leaves a juicy reddish-orange tint with a glazed finish. The feel is light and non-sticky, and the colour can be built up with a second layer.

Key ingredients

  • Alphonso mango pulp extract: gives the balm its mango character
  • Mango butter: a soft plant butter that cushions dry lips
  • Coconut milk: a creamy ingredient that helps lips feel soft
  • Olive squalane: a light oil that helps lips feel smooth
  • Shea butter and sweet almond oil: nourish and soften

How to use

Swipe over clean lips whenever they feel dry. Add a second coat for a deeper tint. For a smoother base, use a gentle lip scrub first, but not on cracked or sore lips.

Good to know

  • Size: 10 g
  • Contains sweet almond oil and vitamin E
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Key ingredients on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Rose Milk Lip Balm or Vilvah Natural Lip Scrub

Deyga Charcoal Bath Bar is a handmade 130 g soap for face and body, made with activated charcoal, extra virgin coconut oil, olive oil and unrefined shea butter. Tea tree hydrosol and tea tree oil give it a clean, fresh scent, and the charcoal gives the bar its deep black colour. Its lather leaves skin feeling clean and refreshed.

Key ingredients

  • Activated charcoal: a fine black powder that helps lift away surface dirt
  • Extra virgin coconut oil: gives a rich, bubbly lather
  • Unrefined shea butter: a plant butter that helps skin feel soft after washing
  • Olive and castor oils: add a creamy, conditioning feel to the foam
  • Aloe vera extract: a gentle plant addition

How to use

Wet the bar and your skin, work up a lather on your hands or a loofah, then massage over the body or face and rinse well. Keep away from the eyes.

Good to know

  • Size: 130 g bar
  • For face and body
  • Contains tea tree essential oil, so patch test before first use
  • Official UK partner of Deyga, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Deyga Organic Loofah or Deyga Chocolate Body Butter

Deyga Tangerine Cleansing Balm for Makeup Removal is a 30 g oil-based balm that melts on the skin to dissolve makeup, including waterproof makeup, along with sunscreen and the day's dirt. It is made with tangerine butter, citron (matulanga), extra virgin coconut oil and almond oil. An olive-derived emulsifier lets it turn milky and rinse away with water, leaving skin feeling soft rather than tight.

Key ingredients

  • Tangerine butter: a soft citrus butter that gives the balm its melting texture
  • Extra virgin coconut oil: helps break down makeup and sunscreen
  • Almond oil: a softening oil that leaves skin feeling comfortable
  • Vitamin E: a nourishing addition to the oil blend

How to use

  • With dry hands, massage a small scoop over a dry face.
  • Add a splash of water to turn it milky, then rinse.
  • Follow with a face wash for a double cleanse.

Good to know

  • Size: 30 g
  • Suits dry, oily, combination and sensitive skin
  • Contains almond oil
  • Official UK partner of Deyga, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Deyga Oat Milk Face Wash or Deyga Pure Rose Water Toner

Vilvah Lavender & Sage Deo Shot is a 20 g solid cream deodorant made with virgin coconut oil, shea butter, jojoba oil and cocoa butter. Arrowroot powder and kaolin clay give it a dry, smooth feel, and lavender and sage essential oils give it a calm, herbal scent. It is free from alcohol, silicones and synthetic fragrance, and melts as it touches the skin for a non-greasy finish.

Key ingredients

  • Virgin coconut oil: the softening base that lets the balm glide on
  • Shea and cocoa butters: help underarm skin feel cushioned
  • Arrowroot powder and kaolin clay: give the balm a dry-touch finish
  • Lavender and sage essential oils: give the herbal scent

How to use

Scoop a pea-sized amount with a clean fingertip, warm it for a moment, then smooth over clean, dry underarms. Reapply whenever you like. Avoid freshly shaved or broken skin, and patch test before first use.

Good to know

  • Size: 20 g
  • Suits sensitive skin
  • Contains beeswax
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Deo Shot Rose & Vanilla or Vilvah Goat Milk Body Wash

The Vilvah Neem Wood Comb (Fine & Wide Tooth) comes as a set of two wooden combs, each with a fine-tooth side and a wide-tooth side. They are cut from Indian neem wood, so you get a biodegradable choice in place of a plastic comb. The smooth teeth glide through hair as you detangle.

What it is

  • Neem wood: a light, smooth wood with a natural grain, shaped into a comfortable hand-held comb.
  • Wide teeth: for working through knots after washing or on thicker hair.
  • Fine teeth: for finishing, parting and smoothing once the knots are out.

How to use

  • Start with the wide teeth and comb from the ends, moving up towards the roots a section at a time.
  • Switch to the fine teeth to smooth and part.
  • Wipe the comb with a dry cloth after use and let it dry fully if it gets wet. Keep it out of long soaks.

Good to know

  • Pack of 2 combs
  • Wooden and biodegradable
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Men's Neem Wood Comb or Vilvah Goat Milk Hair Mask

Made for hair and beard, the Vilvah Men's Neem Wood Comb is a pair of wide-tooth combs shaped from Indian neem wood. The well-spaced teeth detangle gently and leave hair and beard feeling smooth and easy to style. It is a simple wooden alternative to a plastic grooming comb from Vilvah.

What it is

  • Neem wood: a smooth, close-grained wood that feels warm in the hand.
  • Wide-tooth design: spaced teeth that move through hair and beard without snagging.
  • Two combs: keep one by the basin and one in a wash bag or gym bag.

How to use

  • For the beard, comb downwards in the direction the hairs lie, ideally after a little beard oil or balm.
  • For hair, work out knots from the ends first, then comb back or to the side to style.
  • Brush out trapped hairs and wipe the teeth with a dry cloth now and then. Let the comb dry if it gets wet.

Good to know

  • Pack of 2 combs
  • Wide teeth for hair and beard
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Neem Wood Comb (Fine & Wide Tooth) or Vilvah Goat Milk Shampoo 250ml

Deyga Charcoal Detox Face Mask is a 100g wash-off face mask made with activated charcoal, tea tree hydrosol and jasmine hydrosol. Guar gum and glycerine give it a smooth, spreadable texture, and it rinses away to leave skin feeling clean and refreshed.

Key ingredients

  • Activated charcoal: a fine black powder that gives the mask its colour and cleansing feel.
  • Tea tree hydrosol: the fragrant water left after distilling tea tree leaves.
  • Jasmine hydrosol: a floral water that adds a soft scent.
  • Guar gum: a plant gum that thickens the mask so it spreads evenly.
  • Glycerine: draws in water so skin feels comfortable after rinsing.

How to use

Smooth a thin, even layer over clean, damp skin, avoiding the eyes and lips. Leave for a few minutes, then rinse with lukewarm water before it dries completely and pat dry. Use once or twice a week and follow with a moisturiser. Patch test before first use.

Good to know

  • 100g jar
  • Suits oily and combination skin
  • Official UK partner of Deyga, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Deyga Tea Tree Facial Toner or Deyga Light Moisturising Face Cream

Rich and creamy, Deyga Chocolate Body Butter is a 100g body butter made with cocoa powder, cocoa butter and shea butter. Almond and jojoba oils make it easy to spread, and the cocoa gives it a light chocolate scent. It is a good pick if you want a body butter for dry skin that feels soft and cushioned after a shower.

Key ingredients

  • Cocoa butter: a firm plant butter that melts on contact and softens skin.
  • Shea butter: a rich butter that leaves dry skin feeling nourished.
  • Almond oil: a light oil that helps the butter glide.
  • Jojoba oil: a smooth liquid wax that leaves skin feeling supple.
  • Vitamin E: a skin-conditioning oil.

How to use

Warm a small scoop between your palms and massage into skin straight after bathing, while it is still slightly damp. Give extra attention to elbows, knees and heels. Use daily or whenever skin feels dry. Patch test before first use.

Good to know

  • 100g jar
  • Suits dry skin
  • Contains almond oil
  • Official UK partner of Deyga, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Deyga Body Scrub or Deyga Rose & Geranium Body Butter

Vilvah Rose Milk Lip Balm is a 10g tinted lip balm inspired by the classic rose milk drink. It is made with paneer rose extract, olive squalane, avocado butter and shea butter, and it leaves a soft pink tint for a fresh, natural flush. A good everyday lip balm for dry lips that you want to look lightly coloured.

Key ingredients

  • Paneer rose extract: a rose extract that gives the balm its rose milk character.
  • Olive squalane: a light oil that helps lips feel smooth.
  • Avocado butter: a creamy butter that softens.
  • Shea butter: a rich butter that cushions dry lips.
  • Vitamin E oil: a conditioning oil, at 1%.

How to use

Glide a thin layer over clean lips and press them together to even out the tint. Apply again whenever lips feel dry, after eating or drinking, or before bed. For smoother application, use a gentle lip scrub first, never on cracked or sore lips. Patch test before first use.

Good to know

  • 10g
  • Soft pink tint
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Key ingredients on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Natural Lip Scrub or Vilvah Mango Shake Lip Balm

Deyga Eyebrow Growth Oil is a 30ml blend of castor, coconut and argan oils with rosemary oil and vitamin E. Tea tree and lavender essential oils give it a fresh herbal scent. The texture is light and non-greasy, so the oil sinks in without leaving brows sticky.

Key ingredients

  • Castor oil: a thick, glossy oil that coats and conditions brow hairs.
  • Coconut oil: a softening oil that makes the blend easy to spread.
  • Argan oil: a light oil that leaves hairs feeling smooth.
  • Rosemary oil: an aromatic plant oil.
  • Vitamin E: a conditioning oil.

How to use

Put one drop on a clean spoolie or fingertip and brush it through clean, dry brows, following their natural direction. Use morning or evening. Keep the oil well away from the eyes and rinse with water if it gets in them. Patch test before first use, as it contains essential oils.

Good to know

  • 30ml bottle
  • Contains tea tree and lavender essential oils
  • Official UK partner of Deyga, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Deyga Tangerine Cleansing Balm or Deyga Under Eye Mask

Deyga Oat Milk Face Wash for Dry Skin is a 100ml cream cleanser made with oat milk, mild coconut-derived cleansers and provitamin B5. A little kaolin clay gives the lather a soft, creamy feel. It washes away dirt and the day's grime while leaving skin feeling soft and comfortable rather than tight.

Key ingredients

  • Oat milk: a creamy oat base that leaves skin feeling soft.
  • Sodium cocoyl isethionate and sodium cocoyl glycinate: gentle coconut-derived cleansers that make a mild lather.
  • Provitamin B5: a conditioning ingredient that helps skin feel moisturised.
  • Betaine: a sugar-beet ingredient that helps hold water in the skin.
  • Kaolin: a soft white clay.

How to use

Wet your face, work a small amount into a lather between your hands and massage over the skin for about 30 seconds, avoiding the eyes. Rinse with lukewarm water and pat dry. Use morning and evening, then follow with toner and moisturiser.

Good to know

  • 100ml
  • Suits dry and sensitive skin
  • Contains added fragrance
  • Official UK partner of Deyga, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Deyga Pure Rose Water Toner or Deyga Deep Moisturising Face Cream

Vilvah Milk Drops Hydrating Serum is a lightweight water-based face serum, sold in 40ml and 20ml bottles. It is made with aloe vera juice, hyaluronic acid and rice milk extract, with natural betaine and glycerin. It sinks in quickly and leaves your face feeling soft, smooth and hydrated, without a heavy layer.

Key ingredients

  • Aloe vera juice: a light, watery base that feels fresh on the skin.
  • Hyaluronic acid: holds water so skin feels hydrated.
  • Rice milk extract: gives the serum its milky character.
  • Natural betaine: a sugar-beet ingredient that helps skin feel moisturised.
  • Glycerin: draws in water for a comfortable feel.

How to use

After cleansing and toning, press two or three drops into the face and neck while the skin is still slightly damp. Let it absorb, then follow with moisturiser, and with sunscreen in the morning. Use once or twice a day. Patch test before first use.

Good to know

  • Sizes: 40ml or 20ml
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Milk Face Toner or Vilvah Ultra Moisturising Cream

Vilvah Cookie N Cream Body Polish is a creamy coffee body scrub in a 200ml jar. Ground coffee and fine tagua seed powder give it gentle grit, while shea butter, olive oil and argan oil sit in a soft cream base. It rinses off clean and leaves skin feeling smooth and soft.

Key ingredients

  • Coffee powder: fine grains that gently buff away dry flakes
  • Shea butter: a rich plant butter that softens and cushions
  • Argan oil: a light oil that leaves skin feeling supple
  • Almond milk extract: a milky extract that adds a creamy feel to the polish

How to use

On damp skin in the shower, massage a scoop over arms, legs and body in small circles, paying a little more attention to elbows and knees. Rinse well with warm water. Use two or three times a week and skip broken or irritated skin. Follow with a body lotion while skin is still slightly damp.

Good to know

  • Size: 200ml
  • Suits oily, dry and combination skin
  • Official UK partner of Vilvah, shipped from the UK
  • Full ingredient list on the Ingredients tab
  • Pairs well with: Vilvah Cookie N Cream Body Mask or Vilvah Milk Body Lotion

The Vilvah Cookie N Cream Body Mask is a smooth kaolin clay mask for the body, made with almond milk extract, coffee extract and niacinamide. It comes in a 200ml tub and spreads easily over larger areas such as arms, legs, elbows and knees. Rinsed off after a short rest, it leaves skin feeling clean and soft.

Key ingredients

  • Kaolin: a soft white clay that gives the mask its creamy body
  • Almond milk extract: a milky plant extract that keeps the clay feeling gentle
  • Coffee extract: gives the mask its cookie and cream character
  • Glycerin: draws in water so skin feels moist after rinsing

How to use
